title: Retrovirus-specific capsid/matrix or envelope profiles withhold the Gypsy call (RETROVIRAL_UNDETERMINED)
trigger: Records with an accepted paired LTR row, an RT hit and a same-strand non-overlapping INT hit lying after the RT (translation order), plus at least one hit from the five profile names. In practice HML-2-like betaretroviral gag (Gag_p24/p24_C/p10) or a betaretroviral/lentiviral/gamma-like env hit by HERV-K_env_2 or GP41. Not triggered when INT precedes RT, when no LTR was accepted, when the only gag/env hits are TLV_coat, zf-CCHC_5 or PEG10_N-capsid, or when the INT is on another strand/overlaps the RT.

labels_renamed: Gypsy (Ty3) -> RETROVIRAL_UNDETERMINED string (conditional re-label for inputs meeting the trigger; 'Gypsy (Ty3)' is still emitted for other inputs)
benchmark_probe: Positive: AY037928 (HERV-K113) and, from the 4.0.0 corpus ERV rows, other HML-2 proviruses such as AY037929 and M14123: 4.0.0 expected LTR/Gypsy High, 4.1.0 expected LTR/unclassified Moderate (verified only for AY037928). Negative/control: M12927 and X01472 (Drosophila gypsy): LTR/Gypsy High in both versions; M11240 and X04456 (Copia) High in both. Boundary: AJ289709 (HERV-H, TLV_coat env) stays LTR/Gypsy High in 4.1.0 (a known residual, expected superfamily Retrovirus/ERV per Wicker). Synthetic: paired 300 bp direct repeats around back-translated RVT_1 consensus then rve consensus (Gypsy order) gives Gypsy High in both versions; adding a back-translated Gag_p24 consensus ORF 5' of the RT is the 4.1.0 trigger (hand-built-row equivalent verified; synthetic with the gag ORF not run).

Boundary: a hand-built INT and TPase pair with overlap exactly half the shorter span (kept = stronger one) and a pair on opposite strands (both kept).
